reason: I make like a thousand bucks a year, so $6 a month for an app that tracks my spending is pretty much the thing I'm trying to cut. If I tried it at all I'd stay on the free tier, and 10 photo fills is enough for my one or two trips to Smith's a week.
objection: It's another subscription, it has no reviews yet, and I can't tell whether the assistant actually reads receipts right or if I'll end up fixing everything by hand anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Solid Play Store ratings and Reddit threads from other U of U students saying the free tier actually saves them money, plus a one-time price or a cheap student price around $1-2 a month.
